scope: scripts/qualify_plcsim_signals.py on a frozen Debug build of 52bed5b3 (artifacts/ps3), 75/75 steps, on one owned PLCSIM Advanced V8 CPU1511 instance on Softbus of an owned scratch CPU 1511-1 PN V4.1. sim_write_signals wrote all eleven primitive types (bool, SInt..ULInt at their range limits, Real 1.5, LReal -2.25e300) in one WriteSignals call and single sim_read calls read them back; sim_read_signals equalled single reads after batch writes and after an independent sim_write. An unknown symbol rejected the whole ReadSignals batch (DoesNotExist, the others SignalConfigurationError, no values); a WriteSignals batch with an unknown symbol failed as PartialSimulationWrite and its valid item was written. sim_area_write of IB20 and IW22 read back through PLC tags and the program's QB20/QW22 copies (high byte first); a symbolic MW30 write read back by address, an area write of MW30 symbolically, the program overwrote an area write of MW32 on its next scan, and bits M34.5 and I20.0 matched their tags. Area sizes: inputs and outputs 32768, markers 16384 bytes. sim_observe saw the program's STP take RUN to STOP with STOP, RUN and ERROR LED changes, a separate PLCSIM API client's Run, Stop, Run as Stop-Startup-Run-Stop-Startup-Run matching the client's log and the polled state, and maxEvents 1 ended a 15 s window after 1.5 s; the display summary reported 41026 bytes. A foreign instance registered by another API client was selectable and observable, refused sim_write_signals and sim_area_write with OwnedInstanceRequired, and was unregistered by that client. Typed refusals for string types, duplicate symbols, bounds, the output area, out-of-area ranges, observation bounds and released instances.
limitations: One owned PLCSIM Advanced V8 CPU 1511 instance on Softbus of an owned scratch CPU 1511-1 PN V4.1, provisioned with first-use TLS trust under the owned-empty-CPU policy like the D09 runner.
Process-image addresses IB20..23, QB20..23 and MB30..34 have no configured I/O module; inputs of configured modules are not exercised.

Operating-state changes inside an observation window came from the program (STP) and a separate PLCSIM API client; the PLCSIM control panel and TIA Portal are not exercised. Display data is summarized by length and hash; its format is not decoded.
